school_name_en: Kiang Wu Nursing College Of Macau
notes: Four taught master's programmes (all nursing/gerontology, evening study, Chinese/English); requirements taken from each programme page's non-local section. No minimum English score is stated for admission (IELTS 6.5 applies only to the optional La Trobe dual-degree track); MANP's non-local window for the next intake is not yet published.

academic.quote: 1. Obtained nursing undergraduate / bachelor's degree and

prerequisites.text: At least one year of nursing work experience, or an excellent fresh nursing graduate
prerequisites.quote: 2. One year or more nursing work experience, or excellent fresh graduates of nursing bachelor's degree.

prerequisites.text: Mainland applicants: sat the latest National Postgraduate Entrance Examination and met the national preliminary line
prerequisites.quote: 3. Students must have participated in the most recent National Postgraduate Entrance Examination. The preliminary examination must meet national requirements.

academic.text: Bachelor's degree or equivalent; preference for health or social work disciplines
academic.quote: A Bachelor's Degree or equivalent qualification recognised by the Academic Committee. Preference will be given to holders of a Bachelor's Degree in a health or social work related discipline (e.g. Medicine, Nursing, Social Work, Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Counselling, etc.).

prerequisites.text: Sat the latest National Postgraduate Entrance Examination and met the national preliminary line
prerequisites.quote: 2. Students must have participated in the most recent National Postgraduate Entrance Examination. The preliminary examination must meet national requirements.

academic.quote: 1. Obtain a Bachelor's degree in Nursing from a higher education institution; and

prerequisites.text: At least three years of clinical nursing experience
prerequisites.quote: 2. At least three years of clinical nursing experience;

prerequisites.text: Mainland National Graduate Entrance Examination taken and national line met, or a related bachelor's from Macao
prerequisites.quote: 3. Having taken the Unified National Graduate Entrance Examination in the Mainland and met the national requirements; or having obtained a Bachelor's degree in a related discipline in Macao.

academic.text: Undergraduate degree in nursing or a healthcare-related discipline
academic.quote: 1.Applicants should possess an undergraduate degree in nursing from a recognized institution; or with an undergraduate degree in healthcare related disciplines; and

prerequisites.text: Preference for 2 years of healthcare work experience or managerial functions
prerequisites.quote: 2.Preference for applicants who possess 2 years of work experience in healthcare related organisation/settings or those with managerial functions; and

prerequisites.text: Mainland students: National Postgraduate Entrance Examination results meeting the national line
prerequisites.quote: 3.Required to submit the National Postgraduate Entrance Examination results reaching the required National requirement; （Mainland students）
